status: isolated diagnostic implementation and one bounded valid live capture completed; production unchanged

buffers.invalidIf: overflow>0 or drainGaps>0 or required spans incomplete
buffers.dropSources: total plus separate Worker/main dropped counters; Worker maximum drained batch and main retained peak recorded

clock.eventTime: session Worker performance.timeOrigin + performance.now() for Rust callback and websocket-delivered events
clock.mainEvents: main document epoch ms; recorded timeOrigin
clock.crossHost: source/calibration request brackets; not exact source frame identity

ids.rust: loop sequence, async prepare-completed uses preparation loop ID

stages.ws-message-delivered: existing stats listener ran; prior to separate gloo listener; bytes only
stages.rdp-loop-state: pending_count/bytes and prepared/preparing/priority bits before select
stages.prepare-call-start/end: synchronous pending H264 chunk extraction/copy and prepare call; end.ok before error propagation
stages.prepare-completed: async preparation future selected; end.ok before error propagation
stages.rdp-network-selected: next_work selected successfully parsed/framed PDU; payload byte count
stages.network-process-start/end: active_stage.process; end includes success and pending queue state
stages.graphics-process-start/end: process_pending_graphics; end includes success and pending queue state
stages.canvas-render-start/end: wait_for_frame continuation including resize/extract_partial_image/gui.draw; end.ok before error propagation
stages.rdp-damage-enqueued: GraphicsUpdate added to Rust damage accumulator
stages.response-enqueued: generic outgoing ResponseFrame accepted by writer queue, not a parsed protocol ACK

limits: WebSocket event delivery is not physical wire arrival.
gloo copy/queue/framing/scheduling can merge or split data; no 1:1 mapping between WebSocket events, PDUs, pictures and display batches.
read_pdu elapsed wait would include waiting and parsing; it is not labeled CPU time.
Response writer queue is not server receipt and not protocol FrameAcknowledge.
Existing ack-sent/ack-received are local main/Worker display acknowledgements.
Trace spans are wall time, not attributed CPU samples.
Enabled hooks add overhead and may affect scheduling; newly observed stalls cannot retroactively explain old runs.
No payload, credential, URL or screen/audio content is logged by flow events.
prepare-completed timestamps future selection, not the earliest completion of its underlying Promise.
Loop-state to the next stage can include select waiting and unrelated JavaScript scheduling.

releaseAb.app: same diagnostics JS with flow off, presentation trace on, snapshotRegions=1, bufferCapacity=1
releaseAb.required: actual worker resource URL plus fetched SHA256 before/after every round; never substitute hook WASM for release timing

overflowAttempt.dropSourceLimitation: Original build reported only aggregate drops, so exact split cannot be recovered from retained events. Main reached its limit; Worker was also limited to 4096 per drain. No causal stall inference from this truncated trace.

validCapture.limitation: No >100ms event captured; no additional chase and no retrospective attribution of prior stalls.
